about.title: About Hawwely
about.subtitle: Helping 14 million Egyptians abroad send more money home
about.missionText1: Every month, millions of Egyptians in the Gulf, Europe and the US send money to their families in Egypt. Most of them lose between 3% and 7% of every transfer to visible and hidden fees without knowing it.
about.missionText2: Hawwely was built to make comparison as easy as booking a flight: type the amount, see every service side by side, and know exactly how many pounds reach your family from each one.
about.missionText3: We are not a bank and not a transfer company. We are an independent comparison platform, and results are always ranked by what your family receives — never by who pays us.
about.moneyText1: Hawwely is 100% free for users. Some services pay us a referral commission when you open an account through our link — at no extra cost to you.
about.moneyText2: That commission never affects the ranking. The service that pays more does not rank first — the service that delivers more money ranks first. Services that pay us nothing are listed exactly the same way.
about.value1Text: We show you the hidden fee nobody talks about.
about.value2Text: Ranked by the numbers only. No paid placements in results.
about.value3Text: Content written in our language, for our problems, by people who send money like you.
about.teamText: Hawwely started as a side project by an Egyptian expat tired of losing money every month. Today a community of volunteers reports rates and reviews content.
about.founderBio: Egyptian expat, software engineer, and monthly sender to family for 10 years.
about.contactText: Have a suggestion? Found a wrong rate? Want to partner with us?
